title: Integrate KNIFE_001 into Unity
goal: Import the approved KNIFE_001 Blender asset into Unity as a playable, inspectable prefab with verified runtime integration.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The exported KNIFE_001 asset exists and is readable by the Unity import pipeline.
The Unity prefab contains the expected renderers, materials, and collider configuration.
Unity enters PlayMode without relevant Console errors.
KNIFE_001 is visibly present in the validation scene.
